On bingxu day the state of Pohuang, on renchen day the state of Boda, both sent envoys presenting local products.
197
秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。
In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Jiang Province, was made Inspector of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan was made Inspector of Yong Province.
198
八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。
In the eighth month, on jiyou day, Prince of Jianping Hong, Central Protector of the Army, was made Inspector of Jiang Province. On guichou day Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Inspector of Xiang Province.
199
冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。
In the tenth month of winter Prince of Guangling Dan was redesignated Prince of Suí. On jiachen day Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Inspector of Yang Province, was made Campaigning-North General, Commissioner with Opening-Office Equal to the Three Dukes, and Inspector of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made Inspector of Yang Province.
200
二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。
In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei day, it was decreed that Jiao and Ning provinces use acting-plaque commanderies and counties and that salaries follow central-government appointments. On xinmao day the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
201
二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。
In the second month, on xinchou day, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Inspector of Yu Province, was advanced to General of the West. On xinhai day [35] the Northern Wei raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun commanderies, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan commanderies, abandoned their posts and fled. The Northern Wei attacked Xuanhu city; Chen Xian, acting for Runan Commandery, resisted them. Because of military exigency the salaries of the hundred offices were reduced by one-third.
202
三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。 戊寅，罷國子學。 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。
In the third month, on yichou day, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same measure as the central hundred offices; thereupon provincial, commandery, and county assistants and commandants were all likewise reduced. On wuyin day the Imperial University was abolished. On yiyou day Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of Personnel, was made General Who Protects the Army.
203
夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。 [36]
In the fourth month of summer, on renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to General Who Stabilizes the Army. The received edition inserts commentary marker thirty-six at this point in the narrative.
204
六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。
In the sixth month, on dingyou day, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
205
秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。
In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu day, Pacifying-North General Wang Xuanmo was sent on a northern campaign. Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong advanced and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all armies. On yihai day the Northern Wei garrison at Quepo abandoned the city and fled.
206
冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。 丙戌，又克關城。
In the intercalary month of winter, on guihai day, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the enemy and retreated to Quepo. On xinwei day Prince of Suí Dan, Inspector of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong city and took it. On bingxu day they again took Tong Pass city.
207
十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。 丁未，大赦天下。
In the eleventh month, on wuzi day, the Northern Wei took Mount Zou; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping commanderies, was captured. On jiawu day the army sent by Prince of Suí Dan again attacked Shan city and took it. On guimao day Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle at the Wei Wu garrison of Shouyang and was killed. On dingwei day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
208
十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。 壬午，內外戒嚴。
In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, strict guard was imposed within and without. On yichou day Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary, Zang Cheng, General of Crossbows for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were defeated in battle at Xuyi by the enemy and all were killed. On gengwu day the enemy's false ruler led a great host to Guabu. On renwu day alert was proclaimed within and without.
209
二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。
On bingxu day, the new moon of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, court audience was not held because the enemy pressed close. On dinghai day the Northern Wei withdrew from Guabu. On dingyou day they besieged Xuyi city. That month Pacifying-North General Wang Xuanmo withdrew from Quepo and returned to Lixia.
210
二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。 東作方始，務盡勸課。 貸給之宜，事從優厚。 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。
In the second month, on bingchen day, the Northern Wei fled in disorder from Xuyi. On guiyou day an edict said: "The Xianyun rage fiercely and hardship reaches several provinces; when I think of them, I wake and sleep in grief. The vicious Jie are wounded and broken and flee to distant parts; the people they have maimed should be restored in timely fashion. In all commanderies and counties that suffered enemy raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and bones, and relieve and support the hungry and displaced. Spring plowing has just begun; exert every effort in encouragement and supervision. As to lending and granting, matters should follow generous treatment. Those who have drifted and sojourned along the Jiang and Huai are all permitted to register where they now are, and taxes and levies are likewise remitted." On jiaxu day Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, who also held the post of Minister over the Masses, was reduced to Rapid-Cavalry General with Opening-Office Equal to the Three Dukes. On xinsi day Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Stabilizes the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced to North-Central Commander. On renwu day the Emperor visited Guabu; that day alert was lifted.
211
三月乙酉，車駕還宮。 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。
In the third month, on yiyou day, the Emperor returned to the palace. On renchen day Campaigning-North General Prince of Shixing Jun relinquished Southern Yan Province. On gengzi day Zang Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Inspector of Yong Province. On wushen day Prince of Wuling Jun, Inspector of Xu Province, was made Inspector of Southern Yan Province. On jiayin day Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces.
212
夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on guiyou day, the state of Boda sent envoys presenting local products. The Northern Wei's false Pacifying-South General Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu submitted to allegiance. On wuyin day Shuang was made Inspector of Si Province.
213
五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。 [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。
In the fifth month, on yiyou day, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city. On dingsi day the state of Pohuang, on wuxu day the King of Henan, both sent envoys presenting local products. [37] On jisi day Rapid-Cavalry General Prince of Jiangxia Yigong additionally held the post of Inspector of Southern Yan Province. On wushen day He Shangzhi, Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat on the left, was made Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Xu Zhan, Steward of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and General Who Protects the Army. On renzi day Prince of Suí Dan, General of the Rear, was made Pacifying-South General and Inspector of Guang Province.
214
六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。
In the sixth month, on renxu day, North-Central Commander Prince of Wuling Jun was made Inspector of Jiang Province, and Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Might and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.
215
秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。
In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen day, Pacifying-East General King of Wa Wa Ji was advanced to Pacifying-East Grand General.
216
八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。
In the eighth month, on guihai day, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
217
冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。
In the tenth month of winter, on guihai day, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
218
十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。
In the eleventh month, on renyin day, a partial amnesty was granted in the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji provinces. That winter displaced people from Pengcheng were moved to Guabu and those west of the Huai to Gudu, together numbering about ten thousand households.
219
二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。 今農事行興，務盡地利。 若須田種，隨宜給之。」
In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu day, an edict said: "Six provinces have suffered raids and settled livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met flood disaster and hunger and distress come in succession. Orders should quickly be sent to the various garrisons to grant relief by generous measure. Now farming is about to begin; exert every effort for the land's benefit. If seed for fields is needed, grant it as circumstances require."
220
二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。
In the second month, on gengshen day, the enemy leader Tuoba Tao died. On wuwu day [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
221
夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。
In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu day, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products. Zhang Yong, Staff Officer of the Rapid-Cavalry General, was made Inspector of Ji Province.
222
五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。 」是月，京邑雨水。
In the fifth month, on jiawu day, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province. The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on bingshen day an edict said: "Evil ripened and the body perished; the Rong villains are a constant tally; the cruel enemy's utmost viciousness has been manifest since of old. Without our yet having to spend the army’s strength, they have already fallen under Heaven’s judgment; their sons and grandsons turn on one another, kin and allies divide; the false leaders of Guan and Luo all hold secret intent to submit, and the people left north of the Yellow River offer their loyalty and beg to serve. To save the drowning and cleanse away corruption—the hour has come. Orders shall go to the General of Agile Cavalry and the Minister of Works, that each command under them coordinate east and west as the situation requires. Those who come over in loyalty and win merit shall be recompensed according to their service. That month the capital was deluged by rain.
223
六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。
In the sixth month, on jiyou day, envoys of the Ministry of Transport were sent on circuit to distribute firewood and grain and to provide boats. Pacifying-Army General Xiao Sihua led an army north. Liu Yu, Acting Staff Officer of the Campaigning-North General, was made Inspector of Yi Province.
224
秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。
In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen day, Prince of Yingyin Hun was redesignated Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was redesignated Prince of Xiangdong. On dingyou day the posts of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Steward of the Heir Apparent, and Supervisor of the Court of Justice were abolished.
225
八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。
In the eighth month, on dingmao day, Xiao Sihua attacked Qiaolao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.
226
九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。
In the ninth month, on dinghai day, Murong Shibin of Tuyuhun, Pacifying-West General, was made Pacifying-Anxi General and Inspector of Qin and He provinces. On jichou day Xiao Sihua, Pacifying-Army General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally made Inspector of Ji Province; his Yan inspectorship was unchanged.
227
冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。
In the tenth month of winter, on guihai day, Lu Shuang, Inspector of Si Province, attacked Hulao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.
228
十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。
In the eleventh month, on renyin day, Prince of Luling Shao, Inspector of Yang Province, died.
229
十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。
In the twelfth month, on xinwei day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Yan Province, was made Grand General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, continuing as Recorder of the Imperial Secretariat.
230
三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。 以南兗州并南徐州。 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。
In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on wuyin day, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, Minister of Works and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Minister over the Masses, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Yang Province. Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province. On gengchen day Liu Zunkao, Commandant of the Army, was made Pacifying-West General and Inspector of Yu Province. On renwu day Prince of Shixing Jun, Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province, was made General of the Guard and Inspector of Jing Province. On wuzi day Prince of Jiangzhou Jun, Inspector of Jiang Province, took overall command of the armies campaigning against the Xiyang barbarians. On guisi day Prince of Nanping Shuo, Inspector of Yu Province, was made Pacifying-Army General and Commandant of the Army.
231
青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。
Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; in the second month, on renzi day, the Transport Ministry was dispatched to grant relief.
232
甲子，上崩于含章殿。 時年四十七。 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。
On jiazi day the Emperor died in the Hall of Combining Splendor. He was forty-seven years old. His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name was Zhongzong. In the third month, on guisi day, he was buried at Everlasting Peace Mausoleum. When Emperor Xiaowu took the throne, the posthumous title and temple name were revised retroactively.
233
史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。 嗚呼哀哉！
The Historian says: In childhood the Founding Emperor stood alone in excellence; he had no stern keepers and tutors, yet Heaven granted him a nature both harmonious and quick, and of himself he possessed the virtue of a true sovereign. Once enthroned and facing south, he ruled long; the cords of government were fully drawn, laws and bans lucid and tight; penalties had their constant scale and no rank was given without cause. Hence the inner realm was pure and the outer calm, and all within the four seas was still. Of old the Eastern Han would cite the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; after that age, too, men repeatedly held up the Yuanjia years—so great indeed was that time. In appointing generals and sending commanders he broke with the old rule of dividing territorial authority; though his gifts did not match Emperor Guangwu’s, he still directed strategy from afar, so that when armies clashed and fighting dragged on, all alike waited upon the finished command from the throne. Though forces were broken and hosts lost, his commanders were no Han Xin or Bai Qi—yet the lingering of enemy incursions and the shame brought upon the frontiers owed chiefly to this. And when whispers escaped the bed-curtain and grievance bound itself to peddlers of old, though calamity came unbidden, there was reason enough that it should. Alas—how mournful!
234
校勘記
Collating Notes
235
車駕至京城孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。 京城則京口矣。 」按通鑑作建康。 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。
When the imperial carriage reached the capital city—Sun Ao’s Song Shu Textual Studies argues that the text should read capital seat. Capital city would mean Jingkou. The Comprehensive Mirror reads Jiankang here. In the Song Shu, jingcheng often refers to Jingkou; in this passage it refers to Jiankang.
236
辛未車駕祠南郊各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。
“On xinwei day the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb”—all received editions omit xinwei; the date is restored from the History of the Southern Dynasties, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and the Comprehensive Mirror.
237
建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。
“Administrator of Jian’an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed”—all editions read Pan Cheng for Pan Sheng; corrected from the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
238
乙卯各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。
“On yimao day”—all editions read jimao; emended from the Bureau edition and the History of the Southern Dynasties. That month began on dingyou; the nineteenth day is yimao—jimao is impossible.
239
領平北將軍南徐州刺史各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。
“Concurrently Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province”—all editions drop nan “southern”; the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Veritable Records of Jiankang, and the Comprehensive Mirror all give Southern Xu; nan is restored.
240
以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。 今據補。
“Former Campaigning-Barbarians Staff Officer Yin Chong was made Inspector of Si Province”—all editions omit Yin; the Account of the Northern Barbarians and the Comprehensive Mirror both place Yin Chong in that office; Yin is restored. The name is now restored.
241
征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張各本並脫「平」字。 據檀道濟傳補。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」
“Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the northern barbarians at Dongping Shouzhang”—all editions omit ping. Ping is supplied from the biography of Tan Daoji. Hong Yixuan’s Comparative Studies of the Various Histories notes: “In the biography of Tan Daoji the place reads Dongping Shouzhang; here ping is missing after dong.”
242
苟不深存務本各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。
“If one does not deeply preserve the root of affairs”—all editions omit gou; the word is restored from Imperial Readings, juan 198.
243
以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。 魏書作「慕利延」。
“Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was made Pacifying-East General”—the Account of Tuyuhun in this book reads Mu Yan for Murong Yan. The Wei Shu gives the form “Mu Liyan.”
244
吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。
“Huifa of Tuyuhun was made General Who Stabilizes the Army”—all editions drop gu from Tuyuhun; restored by parallel passages in the chapter. The Wei Shu reads Weidai for Huifa.
245
壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
“On renshen day the state of Henan and King Hexi sent envoys presenting local products”—all editions read King Xihe; corrected from the Annals of the Deposed Emperor (Jingping 1) and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
246
亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。
“The outlaw Ma Daxuan and his band of several hundred men raided Mount Tai”—the Three Dynasties edition reads Mount Tai; the Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Palace, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.
247
夏四月乙酉按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。
“In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou day”—that month began on dinghai; yiyou is impossible. The twenty-third day is jiyou; yiyou is likely a scribal error for jiyou.
248
秋七月辛酉「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。
“In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou day”—all editions read yiyou; corrected from the History of the Southern Dynasties. That month began on gengxu; the sixth day is xinyou—yiyou cannot stand.
249
於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。 」按孫說是，今訂正。 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。
“The three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province”—all editions compress the names to Southern Jinshou, Xinba, and Brazil. Sun Ao’s Song Shu Textual Studies states: “According to the Treatise on Provinces and Commanderies, the three are Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi.” Sun’s reading is accepted; the text is emended accordingly. In the same entry the upper line gives renshen and the lower yihai. That month began on bingxu; neither renshen nor yihai is possible.
250
以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。 」按張說是，今改正。
“Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin provinces”—all editions read Liu Daozhen for Liu Zhendao. Zhang Senkai’s Collation Notes argue: “The name should be Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; the entry for year eighteen also has Liu Zhendao.” Zhang’s argument is accepted; the name is emended.
251
河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。
“The state of Henan, King Hexi, and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products”—all editions read King Xihe; corrected from the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
252
燕王弘遣使獻方物「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。
“Prince of Yan Hong sent envoys presenting local products”—all editions read Nian for Hong; corrected from the Jin Shu annals.
253
今年有不收處「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。
“This year there are places of no harvest”—all editions read half for year; corrected from Imperial Readings, juan 489.
254
以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」
“Guanglu Grandee Wang Qiu was made Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat”—all editions read Wang Lin; corrected from the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror. Hong Yixuan’s Comparative Studies notes: “Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a copyist’s error.”
255
夏五月壬午「壬午」各本作「壬申」。 局本作「壬午」。 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。 今從局本。
“In the fifth month of summer, on renwu day”—all editions read renshen. The Bureau edition has renwu. That month began on renwu; renshen is impossible. The Bureau reading is adopted.
256
尚書僕射王球卒「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。
“Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Qiu died”—all editions read Lin for Qiu; corrected from the History of the Southern Dynasties and the Comprehensive Mirror.
257
是月各本並作十二月。 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。 今改作是月。
“That month”—all editions read twelfth month. The tenth and eleventh months already appear above; a second twelfth month is out of place. The phrase is emended to “that month.”
258
盛王聖世「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。
“Beginning to offer the autumnal offering in a flourishing age”—all editions read zu (ancestor) for sheng (sage/flourishing); corrected from Imperial Readings, juan 194.
259
始奉礿祠「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。
“First performing the yue offering”—all editions read chu for yue; corrected from Imperial Readings, juan 207.
260
庚申各本同。 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。 下有甲申，為十三日。 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。 庚申疑庚辰之譌。
“On gengshen day”—all editions agree. That month began on renshen; the third day is jiaxu—gengshen cannot occur in this month. Below appears jiashen, the thirteenth day. Between jiaxu and jiashen stands gengchen. Gengshen is likely a scribal error for gengchen.
261
南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西各本同。 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。
“Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang provinces west of the Zhe River”—all editions agree. The History of the Southern Dynasties inserts Southern Yan after Southern Xu.
262
南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。 今改作「駿」。
“Inspector of Southern Yu Province Prince of Wuling Jun was additionally made Pacifying-Army General”—all editions read Zan; the Three Dynasties edition gives the tabooed form. At this date the Prince of Wuling was Jun—the future Emperor Xiaowu. Zan was Emperor Ming’s ninth son, later also Prince of Wuling, but was not yet born. The name is emended to Jun.
263
征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。
“Campaigning-North General and Inspector of Southern Xu Province Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Jing Province”—all editions drop nan from Southern Xu; restored from the biography of Yixuan.
264
九月己未「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。 今從局本。
“In the ninth month, on jiwei day”—all editions read yimao; the Bureau edition has jiwei. That month began on dingsi; the third day is jiwei—yimao is impossible. The Bureau reading is adopted.
265
遷漢川流民於沔次「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。
“Han River migrants were relocated to the banks of the Mian”—all editions read Han Province; no such province existed then; corrected from Imperial Readings, juan 486.
266
三月丁巳下有乙丑。 各本同。 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。
“In the third month, on dingsi day”—yichou follows below. All editions agree on both dates. That month began on dingmao; neither dingsi nor yichou is possible. In the fourth month the first day is bingchen, the twenty-second dingsi, and the thirtieth yichou.
267
辛亥各本並作「辛巳」。 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。 辛巳當作辛亥。 」今據改。
“On xinhai day”—all editions read xinsi. The Comprehensive Mirror’s Textual Notes state: “By the long calendar, in the second month the first day is renchen, the tenth xinchou, the twentieth xinhai. Xinsi should be emended to xinhai.” The date is corrected on that authority.
268
安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍「駿」宋本作「諱」。 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。
“Pacifying-North General and Inspector of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was reduced in title to General Who Stabilizes the Army”—the Song edition gives the tabooed form for Jun. The Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Palace editions read Zan; the name is now set according to the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu. See Collation Note 30 in this fascicle.
269
五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。 丁巳日支當有誤。
“On yiyou day the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou; on dingsi day Popo and on wuxu day King Henan sent envoys with tribute”—in the fifth month of that year the first day was jiashen, the second yiyou, the fifteenth wuxu; dingsi cannot stand. The dingsi line is corrupt.
270
居業未立「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。
“Their livelihoods not yet established”—all editions read able for established; corrected from Imperial Readings, juan 195.
271
戊午各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。 初九日戊午。
“On wuwu day”—all editions read gengwu; corrected from the History of the Southern Dynasties. That month began on gengxu; gengwu is impossible. The ninth day is wuwu.
